description: Source code for 'export' command group in Mattermost's CLI, managing export files and jobs including create, list, delete, download, generate URL, show, and cancel operations.

methods.name: exportCreateCmdF
methods.description: Creates an export process job with options for including attachments, archived channels, profile pictures, and roles/schemes.

methods.name: exportGeneratePresignedURLCmdF
methods.description: Generates a presigned URL for an export file.

methods.name: exportDownloadCmdF
methods.description: Downloads an export file, with support for retries and file handling.

methods.name: downloadFile
methods.description: Handles the logic for downloading files with retries and file permission management.

methods.name: exportJobShowCmdF
methods.description: Shows details of a specific export job.
